scenario: An organization is operating a enterprise workload for AWS IAM & Security. The engineering team needs to satisfy AWS architectural best practices regarding Domain 1: Cloud Concepts. Which architectural design fulfills these requirements with minimal operational overhead?

options.text: Implement AWS IAM & Security using AWS recommended managed architecture with automated multi-AZ failover and IAM encryption.
Deploy self-managed EC2 instances running custom scripts to sync data without leveraging AWS native IAM authentication.
Configure AWS CloudWatch alarms with automated EventBridge targets for continuous governance of AWS IAM & Security.
Utilize manual snapshots exported to local storage on a periodic schedule without KMS key rotation.

explanation: According to the official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) exam blueprint, option(s) A align with AWS best practices for Domain 1: Cloud Concepts and AWS IAM & Security.
